# Real G outputs

From the owner's ChatGPT runs of Photographic Studio v1.0.1 on 2026-11-13. Per case: `original.jpeg` (the bytes ChatGPT
received), `g.png` (the G intermediate as the image tool returned it), `params.json` (the director's grade parameters),
`receipt.json` (ChatGPT's finish.py receipt). 01 garden in backlight, 02 bronze sword (museum), 03 study window,
04 screen and narrow window, 05 lake framed by branches. Do not change these files; add new cases as new folders.
